package.name: phpdocumentor
package.title: phpDocumentor
package.description:
The phpDocumentor platform: the legacy tag family defined by phpDocumentor that a modern, static-analysis-oriented docblock rarely uses.
It contributes these older tags and the few combinators only they rely on.

tag.name: access
tag.summary: The `@access` tag documents the visibility of an element.

example.title: Documenting a magic property as effectively private.
With a description explaining the reasoning.

tag.name: author
tag.summary: The `@author` tag documents the author of an element.

example.title: Just a name, with no way to contact them directly.
A name with an email address for follow-up questions.

tag.name: category
tag.summary: The `@category` tag organizes groups of packages together.

example.title: Placing a package under a broad category.

tag.example: /** * @category Database * @package Connection */

example.title: With additional context about the grouping.

tag.example: /** * @category Database Drivers and connection pooling for relational * stores. */

tag.name: copyright
tag.summary: The `@copyright` tag documents the copyright information of an element.

example.title: A copyright notice naming the holder and year.
A range of years, used on a file that has been maintained over time.

tag.name: example
tag.summary: The `@example` tag points at an external source that illustrates the use of the documented element, optionally narrowing it to a range of lines starting at a line and spanning a number of lines.

example.title: Pointing at an entire example file.

tag.example: /** * @example docs/examples/mailer-basic.php */ public function send(Message $message): bool

example.title: Narrowed to the lines that show the relevant usage.

tag.example: /** * @example docs/examples/mailer-retry.php 12 8 Configuring a retry * policy. */ public function withRetries(int $attempts): static

tag.name: filesource
tag.summary: The `@filesource` tag tells documentation tooling to include the source of the current file in its output.

example.title: Requesting the source listing for an entire file.

tag.example: /** * Mailer transport implementations. * * @filesource */

example.title: With a description explaining why the listing is useful here.

tag.example: /** * @filesource Reference implementation; read alongside the * interface. */

tag.name: global
tag.summary: The `@global` tag documents a global variable that a function relies on.

example.title: Documenting a global relied upon inside the function body.
With a description explaining how the global is used.

tag.name: ignore
tag.summary: The `@ignore` tag tells documentation tooling to skip the element it is attached to.

example.title: Hiding a helper method from generated documentation.
With a description explaining why it's excluded.

tag.example: /** * @ignore Scaffolding left over from the migration; will be * removed. */

tag.name: inheritDoc
tag.summary: The `@inheritDoc` tag reuses the documentation of the parent element.

example.title: As a standalone tag, inheriting the parent docblock wholesale.

tag.example: /** * @inheritDoc */ public function send(Message $message): bool

example.title: Used inline, to graft an addition onto the inherited text.

tag.example: /** * {@inheritDoc} Also flushes the queue before * returning. */ public function send(Message $message): bool

tag.name: license
tag.summary: The `@license` tag pointing to the license text by a URL.
tag.description: The `@license` tag documents the license that applies to an element, given either as a URL to the license text or by its name.

example.title: Pointing at the canonical license text.
Naming the license without a URL.

tag.name: name
tag.summary: The `@name` tag assigns an alias to a procedural page or global variable so that it can be referred to by that alias in the generated documentation.

example.title: Giving a global configuration array a clearer alias.

tag.example: /** * @global array $config * @name config */

example.title: With a description explaining the alias.

tag.name: package
tag.summary: The `@package` tag categorizes elements into a logical subdivision.

example.title: Grouping a class into a package.
With a short description of the grouping.

tag.example: /** * @package Mail Everything related to composing and sending * messages. */

tag.name: since
tag.summary: The `@since` tag documents the version at which an element became available.

example.title: A method added in a later minor release.

tag.example: /** * @since 1.3 Added to support batched sends. */ public function sendMany(iterable $messages): void

example.title: Just the version, with no further explanation needed.

tag.name: source
tag.summary: The `@source` tag points at a range of lines of the documented element's source, starting at a line and optionally spanning a number of lines.

example.title: Excerpting a specific block of the method's own body.
From a given line through the rest of the element, with a description.

tag.name: static
tag.summary: The `@static` tag declares a method or property as static.

example.title: Declaring a magic property as static.
With a description explaining the intent.

tag.name: staticvar
tag.summary: The `@staticvar` tag documents the type of static variable declared within a function or method, optionally naming the variable it applies to.

example.title: Documenting a static counter's type.
Naming the type alone, with a description but no explicit variable.

tag.name: subpackage
tag.summary: The `@subpackage` tag categorizes elements into a logical subdivision below their package.

example.title: Narrowing a package into a specific subsection.
With a description of what the subsection covers.

tag.example: /** * @subpackage Transport Concrete delivery mechanisms for outgoing * mail. */

tag.name: todo
tag.summary: The `@todo` tag records a task that still needs to be done for an element.

example.title: Describing the outstanding work directly.

tag.example: /** * @todo Support cancellation once the transport exposes it. */ public function send(Message $message): bool

example.title: Referencing a tracking issue alongside the description.

tag.example: /** * @todo Validate recipient addresses before dispatch (see * ISSUE-482). */

tag.name: used-by
tag.summary: The `@used-by` tag indicates that the described element is used by the referenced one.

example.title: A low-level helper documenting a caller it must stay compatible with.
With a description explaining the dependency.

tag.name: uses
tag.summary: The `@uses` tag indicates that the described element uses the referenced one.

example.title: A method documenting the helper it relies on.
With a description explaining the dependency.

tag.name: version
tag.summary: The `@version` tag documents the current version of an element.

example.title: Tagging a class with the release it ships in.
With a short description alongside the version.
